'''Iope''' was the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]], in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]]. It was here that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] hired a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to hunt down and kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="RF4" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] discovered an eerie and dense growth of [[Berry/Legends|berries]] in the [[Knurled Highlands]] of Iope. They were considered the only remaining evidence that there had been a settlement in the region eons ago.<ref name="IopHarvest" />
